name: Zendesk
one_liner: Customer support platform offering ticketing, messaging, help center and custom data APIs.
auth_notes: OAuth access tokens sent as Bearer tokens are the supported method. API tokens (Basic auth) are listed as deprecated. Multi-customer apps need global OAuth tokens.
access_notes: Creating OAuth clients and tokens requires an admin or agent with the Manage APIs permission. No price, trial or approval wait is stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Documented API with OAuth Bearer tokens. Multi-customer apps need global OAuth clients. Access tiers, pricing and endpoint counts are not on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: Work with tickets, users and organizations and manage ticket workflows.

auth.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.

access.quote: Only admins or agents with the Manage APIs permission can make the request.

api_surface.quote: APIs and trigger events information for building integrations with Zendesk Integration Services (ZIS)

buildability.quote: If you plan on distributing an app, integration, or bot to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth tokens to authenticate Zendesk API requests.

needs_human_reason: Pricing, access tier, sandbox availability, endpoint count and MCP status are not supported by the fetched pages.
